proxy_note: Real SF move data (names/commands). anim_ref uses the Tekken-bank proxy until SF animations are decoded from PL/*.PAC; frame data estimated from archetype.
sf_translation_contract: 1=LP, 2=MP, 1+2=HP, 3=LK, 4=MK, 3+4=HK; 3P(all punches)=1+2, 3K(all kicks)=3+4; motions preserved: qcf/dp/qcb/hcb/charge/360/720; Akuma-in-T7 pattern
sf_move_provenance: SFEX+alpha move data: 8 specials/supers verified in the SLUS_005.48 binary verbatim list; inputs from the Kao_Megura EX+alpha guide. Aerial Russian Slam flagged EX2+.
frame_convention: SFEX 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled SFEX 144HP -> WH 100HP (x0.69)
